items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: I started arranging for Nat Towles... write some arrangements for him

ctx.x: We got to New York, and they gonna play... They had a date there at the Apollo Theatre, played a week there, and they said I couldn't make that because I wasn't a New York musician. So he just paid me off for the week and give me a week's salary for that week to play in the theatre that I would have played... He just paid me extra; paid me like I already had worked. So I got in my car... I had my wife with me. I got in my car, and drove, came all the way back to Omaha, Nebraska, and I linked up in Sioux City,…
Why did you go to Sioux City or Omaha? Why didn't you go back to Kansas City?
